about: Each case is a violation of P6 planted in plan.md (plan stage) or in the change (review stage). before/ holds the project at the commit the work began on, and project/ the project as the work leaves it, so the change is what differs. 'code' names the rule of cg.py scope that finds its part, or null when only judgement can. '@plan' is the plan of the built project, which the human approved. A finding catches a case when its pointer is 'file' at the line that holds 'text', three lines either way, or is one of 'or', where 'record' is a record under .cg-docs/evidence/. 'work' is the work as it went: for each slice the checks that ran. 'scope' has the runner run cg.py scope once every slice is done, as the work playbook does.

plan.flag: an option that no requirement asks for
a check for a state that cannot occur
a slice that tidies code the goal does not touch

review.flag: a check for a state that cannot occur
